symptom: I can't sign in
causes: The Store ID, username or password is wrong (the message is the same for all three, on purpose).
The login is locked after 5 wrong tries in 15 minutes.
A KloudC master's two-step code is wrong or out of date.
The store is suspended or not set up yet.

items: Check the Store ID in your welcome email. When it is right, the page shows your store's logo.
Type the password carefully: capital letters matter.
Locked? Wait 15 minutes and try again.
Still stuck? Ask an admin at your store to reset your password on Users.

fixes.text: Masters: make sure your phone's clock is right; codes depend on it.

symptom: A tile or report says Couldn't load
causes: A short network problem.
{pos} didn't answer in time.
Your login doesn't have that page.

items: Refresh the page, or pull down to refresh in the app.
Wait a minute and try again: {pos} is sometimes slow.
If it keeps happening on one page, email support with the page name and a screenshot.

symptom: Sales sync failed or looks late
causes: The {pos} connection stopped working (a changed or expired key).
{pos} was down when the nightly sync ran.

items: Open the job status card on Home and read the detail.
An admin opens Integrations and selects Test connection on the POS tile.
If the test fails, re-enter the POS details and Save. A missed night is caught up on the next run.

symptom: My inventory upload was rejected
causes: It isn't {pos}'s retail items export.
The file was opened and re-saved, or columns were renamed.
The file is empty or cut off.

items: Export the retail items report from {pos} again.
Upload it straight away, without opening it in Excel.
If it still fails, email support with the file and the error message.

symptom: Numbers look old
causes: No inventory upload for a few days.
Past sales are from last night's sync; only today is live.
{pos}'s analytics run 2 to 4 hours behind (Insights).

items: Check the job status card on Home for the last upload and sync.
Upload today's inventory, or ask an admin about Inventory from {pos}.
Each page's ⓘ says where its numbers come from and how fresh they are.

symptom: A page is missing from my menu
causes: Your login doesn't have access to it.
It is for admins only.
Your POS doesn't offer what the page needs.

fixes.text: Ask an admin to tick the page for you on [Users](page:users). Search (Ctrl K) only finds pages you can open.

symptom: The Label Scanner link is missing
causes: Your store has no label app set up.

fixes.text: The link only shows when your store has a label app. Ask your owner, or email support to have it added. In the phone app, labels print from the Scan tab.

symptom: Phone alerts aren't arriving
causes: Notifications are off for RetailOps in the phone's settings.
The alert is switched off under More › Notifications.
It is quiet hours (10 PM to 7 AM store time).
You don't have access to the page the alert is about.

items: Allow notifications for RetailOps in your phone's settings.
In the app, open More › Notifications and check the alert is on. Tap Reset to recommended if unsure.
Sign out and in again so the phone registers afresh.

symptom: A WhatsApp message wasn't sent
causes: The WhatsApp connection has stopped working.
The store's number was removed from the group.
WhatsApp was slow; it can take a couple of minutes.

items: Wait a minute: Sending can take a while.
Select Resend on the invoice (or Retry on a flyer).
An admin checks WhatsApp on Integrations with Test connection, and that the number is still in the group.

symptom: The PO email failed or is uncertain
causes: The email connection isn't set up or has stopped working.
A vendor contact's address is wrong.
The connection broke mid-send (uncertain).

items: Failed: read the reason, fix it, then Try again. Nothing in the cart changed.
Uncertain: check the store mailbox's Sent folder, then It went out or Send again.
An admin checks Email on Integrations and the vendor's contacts.

symptom: A delivery isn't suggested
causes: It wasn't received in {pos}, and too few items rose to look like a delivery.
No inventory upload since it arrived.
That vendor's delivery is already logged, or it was dismissed.

items: Receive the delivery in {pos}, then upload today's inventory.
Or tick We received a delivery today on the upload, then Review delivery.
Or log the purchase by hand on Reconciliation.

symptom: An invoice is stuck in In progress
causes: WhatsApp or the {pos} email is still sending, or one of them failed.

fixes.text: Each upload shows WhatsApp and the {pos} email separately. A failed one gets **Resend**. Your upload itself is always saved.

symptom: The app says an update is required
causes: Your app is older than your store needs for something to work.

fixes.text: Update KloudC RetailOps from the App Store or Google Play, then open it again. Your sign-in is kept.

symptom: The camera won't scan
causes: Camera permission is off for RetailOps.
Poor light, glare or a damaged barcode.

items: Allow the camera for RetailOps in your phone's settings.
Hold the phone steady, a little further away, with good light.
Search by name or SKU instead.

symptom: Face ID stopped working
causes: Your password was reset, or you signed out.
Face ID was changed on the phone.

fixes.text: Sign in once with your password, then turn Face ID on again under More › Account.

symptom: A voice note won't record
causes: Microphone permission is off.
Your browser can't record the audio format the phones play.

items: App: allow the microphone for RetailOps in your phone's settings.
Website: recording works in Safari and recent Chrome and Edge. Everyone can play voice notes.

symptom: The demo store won't send anything
causes: The demo store never sends messages, emails or POs, on purpose.

fixes.text: Everything else works so you can look around. Sign in to your own store to send.

symptom: The website looks wrong or out of date
causes: Your browser is showing an old copy.
An old or unsupported browser.

items: Refresh the page (Ctrl Shift R, or ⌘ Shift R on a Mac).
Use a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
Still wrong? Email support with a screenshot and your browser's name.

symptom: How to send us a good support request
causes: We can only fix what we can see.

items: Your **Store ID** and the page you were on.
What you did, what you expected, and what happened instead.
A screenshot, and the time it happened.
Never your password.

fixes.text: The Help Center's Contact tab writes this email for you. Send it to {support_email}.

symptom: Reorder says Check count
causes: {pos} shows 0 or less on hand, but the item still sold in the last 7 days.

fixes.text: You can't sell what isn't there, so the count in {pos} is wrong. Count the shelf, fix it in {pos}, and the next upload clears it.
